sponsored.t: Relates to the residency requirement for the St. Lawrence county public health director and community services director
sponsored.sum: Exempts persons holding the offices of public health director and director of community services of St. Lawrence county from the requirement that such person be a resident of the political subdivision or municipal corporation of the state for which such person shall be chosen or within which such person's official functions are required to be exercised.

sponsored.t: Increases the occupancy tax in the county of St. Lawrence
sponsored.sum: Increases the occupancy tax in the county of St. Lawrence from three to five percent.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "homegrown foods act" to permit the sale of certain homegrown food products without a license under certain conditions
sponsored.sum: Enacts the homegrown foods act to exempt the production and sale of certain homegrown food products grown and processed by a food processing establishment at or in a private residence from certain food processing licensure requirements where the food is sold directly to consumers and total sales do not exceed $12,500.

sponsored.t: Relates to transferring the village of Potsdam housing authority to the village of Canton housing authority; repealer
sponsored.sum: Transfers the village of Potsdam housing authority to the village of Canton housing authority; repeals provisions relating to the village of Potsdam housing authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing guidelines for the connection of utility service for high-usage customers
sponsored.sum: Relates to high-usage customers of electric utilities; establishes guidelines for electric service for high-usage customers; relates to water usage of high-usage customers entering into a high-usage contract with an electric utility or large-scale generation provider.

sponsored.t: Increases the time certain parties have to submit a notice of intent to be a party to the certification proceedings for the siting of major utility transmission facilities
sponsored.sum: Increases the time certain parties have to submit a notice of intent to be a party to the certification proceedings for the siting of major utility transmission facilities from thirty days to forty-five days.

sponsored.t: Relates to termination of service, deferred payment plans and quarterly billing
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of days between the sending of a notice of termination by a utility corporation and the actual date of termination of service; increases the age of residents in the home to 21 from 18 for purposes of special procedures for terminations; decreases the amount required for a downpayment on an arrears on utility bills; lowers the age of customers to whom a utility company must offer quarterly billing from 62 to 55.

sponsored.t: Relates to the inspection of meters and other apparatus used for regulating and supplying gas or electricity by the division of weights and measures
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of weights and measures to inspect meters and other apparatus used for regulating and supplying gas or electricity to verify that such apparatus are properly maintained and calibrated.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing utility rate increase transparency
sponsored.sum: Increases utility rate increase transparency for consumers by requiring additional information be made accessible to the public regarding fuel cost increases and increases in rates or charges.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing workforce stabilization leave and alternative compensation for certain correctional employees during a qualifying emergency period
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of the department of corrections and community supervision to declare a staffing emergency when certain conditions are met; provides that eligible employees may request up to three days of non-cumulative workforce stabilization leave per calendar month during a qualifying emergency period; provides that an eligible employee shall receive alternative compensation if they are unable to utilize their workforce stabilization leave due to operational necessity or if such leave is denied.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "renewable energy project labor agreement act"; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "renewable energy project labor agreement act" in relation to requiring project labor agreements for renewable energy projects receiving state support; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting certified handicapped individuals and senior citizens to use all-terrain vehicles on state land for hunting purposes
sponsored.sum: Permits certified handicapped individuals and senior citizens to use all-terrain vehicles on state land for certain hunting purposes; directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a senior game recovery permit program to allow use of all-terrain vehicles on state lands by senior hunters for the purpose of retrieving big game.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring titling of all motorized recreational vehicles in New York state
sponsored.sum: Requires any motorized recreational vehicle operated, sold or transferred within New York state to be titled with the department of motor vehicles; provides that no person shall sell, transfer or purchase a motorized recreational vehicle without a valid title; directs the department of motor vehicles to maintain a digital database of titled motorized recreational vehicles; provides penalties for noncompliance.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting waiver of dental residency requirements for licensure in underserved areas under supervised practice
sponsored.sum: Provides that the department of education may waive the residency requirement for a license as a dentist for certain applicants who agree to practice in an underserved area of the state under the supervision of a dentist licensed and practicing in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the advanced nuclear energy workforce development commission and the advanced nuclear energy workforce development program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the advanced nuclear energy workforce development commission; directs the advanced nuclear energy workforce development commission to establish and administer the advanced nuclear energy workforce development program.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "responsible neighborhood preservation act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "responsible neighborhood preservation act" in relation to establishing adjusted closing hours for certain licensed premises due to recurring law enforcement interventions.

sponsored.t: Relates to Medicaid accountability
sponsored.sum: Relates to improving Medicaid accountability; verifies Medicaid enrollment data; audits certain Medicaid program areas; creates managed care payment safeguards; establishes a biometric verification pilot program.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Canton to reduce the speed limit on certain public roadways
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Canton to reduce the speed limit on East Main Street to forty miles per hour.

sponsored.t: Relates to the amount of St. Lawrence county economic development power that may be used by the New York Power Authority to generate net earnings
sponsored.sum: Relates to the amount of St. Lawrence county economic development power that may be used by the New York Power Authority to generate net earnings and authority-TMED contracts.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Massena to issue bonds to cover the cost of pension contributions due by the town for employees of the former Massena Memorial Hospital
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Massena to issue bonds to cover the cost of pension contributions due by the town for employees of the former Massena Memorial Hospital.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program authorizing certain nurse aides to administer medication in residential health care facilities in St. Lawrence county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes nursing home medication aides to administer medication in residential health care facilities in St. Lawrence county.

sponsored.t: Establishes the governor's military council
sponsored.sum: Establishes the governor's military council for purposes of growing and protecting major military activities in the state, to leverage such military activities into creating additional defense-related jobs, and to help local units of government improve the quality of life of members of the armed forces and their families in New York state.

sponsored.t: Requires the use of canines for contraband screening at correctional facilities housing one hundred or more incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of canines for contraband screening at correctional facilities housing one hundred or more incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Relates to the removal of weight and height restrictions on vehicles traveling from the Ogdensburg bridge south to the Port of Ogdensburg
sponsored.sum: Removes the weight and height restrictions on vehicles traveling south on the route from the Ogdensburg bridge to the Port of Ogdensburg.

sponsored.t: Establishes the definition for legislation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the definition for legislation; provides that such proposed language shall be presented in a clear and concise manner, be limited to 50 pages and use words that have common everyday meanings.

sponsored.t: Relates to falsely reporting incidents in an attempt to bring about the dispatch of a large number of police officers to a particular address or location
sponsored.sum: Includes falsely reporting incidents in an attempt to bring about the dispatch of a large number of police officers to a particular address or location as a felony offense under the crime of falsely reporting an incident in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Establishes the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program for counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts
sponsored.sum: Establishes the electronic open auction public bond sale pilot program for counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts; provides such provisions shall remain in effect for 3 years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issue of non-commercial drivers' licenses and learners' permits in counties which contain in whole or in part boundary land; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issue of non-commercial drivers' licenses and learners' permits in counties which contain in whole or in part boundary land.

sponsored.t: Grants David Morse, the parent of firefighter Peyton Morse, accidental death benefits
sponsored.sum: Grants David Morse, the parent of firefighter Peyton Morse, who was employed by the city of Watertown, accidental death benefits.

sponsored.t: Requires applicants for certain nursing licenses and certifications to complete training in the prevention of human trafficking
sponsored.sum: Requires applicants for certain nursing licenses and certifications to complete a course in the prevention of human trafficking; directs the commissioners of education and health to develop such training and regulations; directs that certain forfeited funds be used to reimburse actual costs expended for the development of such training.

sponsored.t: Requires the forfeiture by state officers or local officers of STAR exemption eligibility upon conviction of a felony related to public employment
sponsored.sum: Requires the forfeiture by state officers or local officers of STAR exemption eligibility upon conviction of a felony related to public employment.

sponsored.t: Relates to expenses borne by counties outside of the city of New York for the issuance and maintenance of record books utilized by authorized gunsmiths in the sale and disposition of firearms in the state
sponsored.sum: Relates to expenses borne by counties outside of the city of New York for the issuance and maintenance of record books utilized by authorized gunsmiths in the sale and disposition of firearms in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disclosure of monies received by members of the legislature for purposes of legal defense
sponsored.sum: Provides that contributions made by any person, firm, association or corporation to a member of the state legislature which are intended to be used by such member or on behalf of such member for the payment of legal services and other charges in connection with the legal defense of such member in any past or pending civil or criminal action shall be subject to similar monetary limitations and disclosure requirements set forth in the election law pertaining to campaign contributions.

sponsored.t: Permits teachers licensed in another state to teach in New York while completing state-specific teaching certification or licensure requirements
sponsored.sum: Permits teachers licensed in another state to teach in New York while completing state-specific teaching certification or licensure requirements; establishes such requirements must be met within one year from the date such teacher began teaching in New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to annual vehicular access for active duty service members
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to annual vehicular access for active duty service members; requires annual passes be issued to active duty service members and their immediate families at state parks or recreational facilities upon presentation of a military identification card.

sponsored.t: Provides milk dealers and agricultural food product transporters with electronic toll collection devices free of charge
sponsored.sum: Provides milk dealers and agricultural food product transporters with electronic toll collection devices free of charge; requires the department of transportation to reimburse the thruway authority and the metropolitan transportation authority for costs incurred in providing such toll collection devices.

sponsored.t: Requires solar facilities to conspicuously post safety data sheets in areas that may be accessed by emergency responders in the case of a fire or other emergency
sponsored.sum: Requires solar facilities to conspicuously post safety data sheets in areas that may be accessed by emergency responders in the case of a fire or other emergency.

sponsored.t: Establishes the ammunition purchase certification act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the ammunition purchase certification act which requires purchasers of ammunition to have an ammunition purchase permit number.

sponsored.t: Removes residency requirements for Jefferson county assistant district attorneys
sponsored.sum: Removes residency requirements for Jefferson county assistant district attorneys.

sponsored.t: Relates to the ability of a taxing jurisdiction to opt out of the exemption from taxation for certain energy systems
sponsored.sum: Provides that a taxing jurisdiction which has opted out of the exemption from taxation for certain energy systems may not offer the exemption for specific or single projects; requires that a jurisdiction which changes its status relating to the exemption must do so within 120 days prior to the taxable status date; provides that such change shall be valid for one year.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding St. Lawrence county sheriff as an additional firearm licensing officer
sponsored.sum: Relates to adding St. Lawrence county sheriff as an additional firearms licensing officer as well as judges or justices of a court of record having an office in the county of St. Lawrence.

sponsored.t: Eliminates earning limitations for retired persons in positions of public service
sponsored.sum: Eliminates earning limitations for retired persons in positions of public service from 2025 forward.

sponsored.t: Relates to the number of judges of the family court in St. Lawrence county
sponsored.sum: Relates to the number of judges of the family court in St. Lawrence county; adds an additional judge at the same compensation rate.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of SUNY dormitories for the purposes of providing permanent or temporary housing for migrant populations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of SUNY dormitories for the purposes of providing permanent or temporary housing for migrant populations; requests the board of trustees adopt a policy stating such.

sponsored.t: Establishes the reimaging excess New York state property act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the reimaging excess New York state property act; provides the reimaging excess New York state property authority shall purchase any abandoned, surplus or otherwise unused state-owned real property and reconstruct, renovate, replace, maintain, repair, enlarge, extend, operate, lease, as lessee or lessor, and/or regulate the repurposing of such properties.

sponsored.t: Relates to an annual inventory of short-term rental locations and capacities, and monthly utilization data
sponsored.sum: Requires short-term rental companies to provide an annual inventory of short-term rental locations and capacities, and monthly utilization data for each county in the state.

sponsored.t: Provides standards for correctional facilities in relation to medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorders
sponsored.sum: Provides standards for correctional facilities in relation to medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorders and the testing for opioid use when an individual is first incarcerated.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory early closure for premises with a certain number of law enforcement responses in a certain amount of time
sponsored.sum: Relates to mandatory early closure for premises that have had three of more law enforcement responses in a calendar month.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a premises license for businesses retailing certain smoking products and paraphernalia
sponsored.sum: Requires a premises license issued by the department of taxation and finance for businesses retailing certain smoking products and paraphernalia; directs the department to issue regulations.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of theft of an impounded vehicle
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of theft of an impounded vehicle; establishes that such crime is a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Establishing the SUNY excess building asset inventory and repurposing act
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the SUNY excess building asset inventory and repurposing act and conducting a study relating to repurposing or demolishing excess buildings in the state university of New York.

sponsored.t: Mandates pre-trial detention of a principal who stands charged with criminal possession of a controlled substance with intent to sell
sponsored.sum: Mandates pre-trial detention of a principal who stands charged with criminal possession of a controlled substance in the third degree, criminal possession of a controlled substance in the fourth degree, or criminal possession of a controlled substance in the fifth degree.

sponsored.t: Allows certain firearm licensees to open carry
sponsored.sum: Expands the firearm license to have and carry concealed, without regard to employment or place of possession, to include open carry.

sponsored.t: Prohibits roadside signage for the sale of cannabis
sponsored.sum: Prohibits roadside signage for the sale of cannabis or cannabis products on a highway, road, or other vehicular pathway; establishes that a civil penalty of $1,000 shall be assessed for the first offense and a subsequent fine of up to $2,500 for each day that a violation continues.

sponsored.t: Allows for the taxation of state property in the city of Ogdensburg
sponsored.sum: Allows for the taxation of state property located in the city of Ogdensburg, except the lands controlled and operated on by the Ogdensburg Bridge & Port Authority.

sponsored.t: Requires municipal corporations to approve any facility intending to house asylum seekers
sponsored.sum: Requires municipal corporations to approve any facility intending to house asylum seekers prior to their establishment; establishes a review process that incorporates notice to the public and the opportunity for the public to comment; renders a decision within 8 weeks.

sponsored.t: Establishes a third-party vendor program to send certain packages to incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Establishes a third-party vendor program of not more than 10 vendors to send certain packages to incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "comprehensive passenger safety enhancement act"
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the "comprehensive passenger safety enhancement act" to enhance passenger safety in commercial passenger vehicles.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "motor carrier safety compliance requirement act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "motor carrier safety compliance requirement act"; requires companies contracting with motor carriers to verify compliance with safety regulations, maintain proper oversight, and ensure adherence to established safety practices.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "in-route safety inspection for motor coach vehicles act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "in-route safety inspection for motor coach vehicles act"; establishes a framework for mandatory in-route inspections for motor coach vehicles carrying 16 or more passengers to reduce the risk of accidents and enhance operational oversight.

sponsored.t: Provides for a grace period in which former employees of the department of corrections and community supervision that participated in a strike may return to work
sponsored.sum: Provides for a grace period until July 1, 2025, in which former employees of the department of corrections and community supervision that participated in a strike may return to full duty without discipline.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Fort de la Presentation
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting route 68 in the city of Ogdensburg, county of St. Lawrence, to Fort de la Presentation.

sponsored.t: Establishes a digital legal mail program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a digital legal mail program for the delivery of privileged correspondences to incarcerated individuals housed at correctional facilities; requires law offices sending legal mail via digital platforms to incarcerated individuals to register with the department of corrections.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain motor vehicle license plates; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for fines and/or imprisonment for a person who knowingly sells, offers to sell, buys, or offers to buy a false, fraudulent, or stolen license, identification card, certificate of registration, or number plate.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "minivan passenger safety and DOT inspection act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "minivan passenger safety and DOT inspection act" in relation to requiring department of transportation inspection of minivans used for the purpose of transporting passengers for compensation.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of St. Lawrence to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of St. Lawrence to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2027.
